intended_behavior: Adjust to iterate messages from oldest to newest to select the oldest message containing tool results for truncation, thus preserving newer and more relevant results.

Implement truncation only on tool results exceeding configurable size thresholds. Perform partial truncation preserving the beginning and end of content, inserting a truncation marker indicating removed content size. Detect image content in older messages and replace with descriptive placeholders built from available ImageContent metadata, such as filename or source URI when available, or falling back to generic placeholders.

Coordinate truncation using the improved approach prioritizing older messages first, applying size-aware partial truncation with image placeholder replacement, while preserving recent tool results intact to prevent agent confusion or redundant tool invocation.
